about: Blind set for scripts/planner_benchmark.py (--blind). Requests written by two people who had not seen the planner prompt or its family list. One object per request: text is the request as written; inventory is hero_kitchen, kitchen_real_01 or office (python scripts/planner_benchmark.py --dry-run prints each one's object and fixture ids); family is the task the request asks for, one of arrival.sim.tasks.SIM_FAMILIES; object is the object id it names in that inventory, or null; author is A or B; placeholder is true on the example rows below. The script refuses to run the blind set while any row has placeholder true.

requests.text: PLACEHOLDER: could you get the fridge open for me?
requests.author: A

requests.text: PLACEHOLDER: the cup needs a wash, pop it in the dishwasher.
requests.author: B

requests.text: PLACEHOLDER: nudge the book along the table so I have room to write.
requests.author: A
